files.modifications: Adapted affine scaling formula, global and stepwise stats selection, per-embodiment dispatch, constant-field handling, and clipping. Replaced framework utilities with standalone Python and Torch operations; new public API names. Rejects nonfinite statistics, negative standard deviations, and reversed bounds before preprocessing.

New implementation of data assembly contract: metadata field order, padding masks, normalization, and padded delta action semantics. No base processor or framework dependency. Relative joint reference uses first observation; output action decoder retains all horizon steps.
New implementation preserving camera order, RoboTwin 288x256/384x320 mosaics, aspect-preserving resize and crop, CTHW output, and [-1, 1] normalization.

Independent local read-only LeRobot v2 reader; source reviewed for time offsets, endpoint windows, split/filter and statistics behavior. Does not copy vendored LeRobot code. Raises on corrupt samples instead of silently replacing them; supports embedded images and PyAV videos; v3 is explicitly unsupported. Follow-up integrity audit aligns proprio time masks with the cropped horizon, emits native text_tokens/text_valid for compatible Qwen3 caches, validates FPS/timestamp cadence, and restores a strict configurable 1e-4 second video timestamp tolerance. Automatically fitted homogeneous statistics preserve equal-episode/per-step variance aggregation and the per-step quantile envelope. Named-embodiment automatic fitting retains the flattened global quantile/variance recipe separately; numeric embodiment identifiers are normalized to strings to match JSON statistics keys. Cache format metadata lets native policies reject incompatible cached embeddings. Resume fingerprints now include retained video files and configured .pt cache files by path, byte size and modification time; no full media/cache payload hashing is performed. Parquet read-cache keys also include byte size and modification time, preventing reopened datasets from reading stale tables after local replacement. Independent extension adds separate-camera tensors, unaugmented current/past vision-language observations, masked causal history on the original episode clock, and required subtask sentence validation; these new selection settings and labels enter continuation fingerprints.

Reimplemented augmentation API as ClipAugment; preserves one sample-level probability draw, independent camera draws, temporally shared color/gamma/exposure/crop/rotation/noise, operation order, and recipe parameter names.

limitations: LeRobot v3 merged file layouts are not implemented.
Evaluation parity must be validated against a representative existing dataset and checkpoint before replacing a historical pipeline.
Heterogeneous field remapping is not enabled by this initial pipeline.

Dataset fingerprint hashes metadata and statistics content plus selection, parquet/video byte size and modification time, and configured .pt text-cache file metadata. It does not hash complete parquet, video or text-cache payloads; external image files referenced inside parquet image columns are outside this metadata guarantee.
AppearanceRandomizer does not support mask-guided background replacement; requesting enabled background replacement raises NotImplementedError.
